children: Robert A. Frist Jr., a 10% owner serving as CEO and Chairman, sold 144,068 shares of common stock at $29.50 per share. The total sale amount was $4,250,006 in cash pursuant to a privately negotiated Securities Purchase Agreement dated September 11, 2026. Following the transaction, Frist directly owns 3,907,038 shares and indirectly owns 1,098,337 shares.
